datasheet.title: Nokia 7360 ISAM FX-8 Vertical shelf mount kit unit data sheet (3FE 67300 BAAA TQZZA Edition 01)

description: The air intake baffle/drip tray of the 7360 ISAM FX-8 vertical shelf mount kit: the tray that hangs under a vertically mounted shelf and takes two rack units of the elevation. A vertical mount needs one under every shelf, the bottom one included.

gaps.note: Table 3 gives 2.04 kg for the tray and 0.69 kg for the bracket; the weight of the two as one part is the sum and is not stated.

the rest of the kit (the top cross bracket with the rear and front skirts, the intumescent panel, the 23 in. rack adapter brackets and the screws) is not seen from the front of the rack and is not modelled.

model: 7360 ISAM FX-8 vertical shelf mount kit, air intake baffle and drip tray
name: fx8-vertical-air-intake-tray

chassis.note: Nokia 7360 ISAM FX-8 Vertical shelf mount kit unit data sheet (3FE 67300 BAAA TQZZA Edition 01), Table 3: the tray is 89.02 mm high, 251.97 mm wide and 350.01 mm long. Read as height up the rack, depth, and width across it, which Figure 84 of the 7360 ISAM FX ANSI Hardware Installation Manual (3HH-12893-AAAA-TCZZA Issue 29) supports: the tray is a little narrower than the 355 mm the shelf stands across the opening.

color.note: the held figures are line art and no photograph is held, so the colour is a neutral metal grey and is not a reading.

ears.note: no ears. Figure 84 of the installation manual (printed page 168) draws the tray as an open box between the posts, narrower than the opening, with no ear, flange or bolt to a post. It hangs under the shelf's bracket.

parts.note: the tray comes pre-assembled with the shelf horizontal mounting bracket (25.40 mm high, 486.41 mm long, Table 3), which the installation manual's step 5 of Procedure 31 fixes to the rack; the bracket is not drawn apart from the shelf it carries.

units.note: two rack units, read from Figure 84 of the installation manual, where the tray fills the two units under the shelf and the next shelf's tray stands 15 units above it; 89.02 mm is 2.003 units. No table prints the units.

references.title: Nokia 7360 ISAM FX ANSI Hardware Installation Manual (3HH-12893-AAAA-TCZZA Issue 29; section 9.2.2, Figures 82 and 84)
